empty.title: No session selected
empty.hint: Select a session to see its details, files and actions. Use the checkboxes for bulk actions.

block.live: Attached to a live Claude Code process ({{state}}, PID {{pid}}{{name}}). Close that session before deleting.
block.liveArchive: Attached to a live Claude Code process ({{state}}, PID {{pid}}{{name}}). Close that session before archiving or deleting.
block.unknown: Claude process status is unknown. Refresh the process status first.
block.desktop: Close Claude Desktop before modifying session files.
block.codexRecent: Codex wrote to this session less than 2 minutes ago, so it may still be running. Archive and delete are blocked until it stops.

action.openProjectHint: Open the workspace folder in Explorer
action.archiveHint_codex: Ask Codex to archive it ("codex archive"): Codex moves its file to archived_sessions
action.restoreHint_codex: Ask Codex to restore it ("codex unarchive")

note.storeDesktop: Microsoft Store edition: this session has Claude Desktop metadata, so it can be viewed and exported here, but not archived, restored or deleted. Windows Store packaging isolates certain AppData writes, and Claude Desktop would not see such changes.
note.armed: Real Delete Armed — Delete permanently will really remove this session's files.
note.codexCliMissing: The Codex CLI was not found, so this session can be viewed, exported and hidden, but not archived or deleted. Install it with "npm i -g @openai/codex", then refresh.

hint.rawTitle: The exact title field in the Claude Desktop metadata file
hint.projectPath: Canonical workspace (real cwd). Never part of a delete plan.
hint.internalId: Internal ID assigned by this app
hint.messages: Prompts = meaningful user prompts. Assistant messages = distinct model responses (one per step; one prompt usually produces many, because every tool-use step is a separate response). Tool calls = tool_use blocks.

titleSource.custom-title_codex: Name you gave it in Codex

projectSource.decoded-folder-name: Claude storage folder name, matched to a real folder

file.priorTranscript_codex: File of a session it started

export.note: Exports are copies; originals are never modified.
